reason: I'd happily play with the free tricks at Friday dinner and wow the kids, but 99 shekels for an app is way past what I ever pay for software. The free ones will probably be enough for me.
objection: 99 ₪ is a lot for an app when most are free or a few shekels, and it's installed from a website instead of the App Store and paid by card there, so I'm not sure I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the kids go crazy over the free tricks and the full version drops to around 20-30 ₪, I might pay once.
